rules: Query all 1803 original native inputs before reporting a comparison. Within each input enumerate the complete native population before independent location pairing. Enumerate native typed fields, unused/unnamed declarations, unresolved/external/unsupported outcomes and every service/route/plugin scope; no independent parser chooses native definitions or reference denominators.

Preserve raw typed Host/URL before native normalization using the verified read-only source observer. Go forbids overlays below GOMODCACHE, so overlay a byte-verified private source copy with a scratch modfile; never edit the dependency cache or global configuration.

The host contract is strict literal native upstream NAME equality. A registry's name-or-ID lookup must not create an upstream-ID host alias. Explicit service/route foreign keys use the owner's native resolver and registry outcomes; nested implicit containment is not relabelled as a written field.

First require the source-identified native binary, authored race tests, raw-field and native-scope mutation FAIL-to-GREEN, actual extractor-output tripwire, input sensitivity, cap+1 refusals and network-denied official decK cross-checks. The tripwire alone proves no independence claim.

L1 positions remain C from the existing independent yaml.v3 locator. Match every named native entity one-to-one to a located entity; refusal on missing, extra or ambiguous population. No A range claim and no scanner fallback for missing native facts.

Native source1MiB/entity-and-field10000/output8MiB caps and 30-second child timeout refuse the whole input/output. No partial refused output becomes truth. External plugin config sources and unsupported typed scopes fail closed until a bounded native route is built.

Use no Docker, server, backend, paid call, global install or subject code execution. Native HTTP requests are denied; clean private HOME/environment, two Go workers, bounded child output, private caches, nice10, serial heavy runs, df/free>=20GiB. T-R10 permits this correctness replay to start at 1-minute load<=9. Throughput requires load<=6 and a median of three with conditions; otherwise report throughput and performance-dependent grade as unmeasured.

Publish ordinal cohort counts, ratios, source hashes, scope/model exclusions and identity receipts only.
